description: Objects that authenticate (the AEAD opens or the MAC verifies with the listed key) but break a decode rule. Every case must be rejected with an integrity error.

cases.name: path with a C1 control character
conflict-of naming the entry's own path
cases.rule: conflict-of is a valid path other than the record's own

cases.name: object not a multiple of 4096 bytes
device kem_ek fails the FIPS 203 encapsulation-key check
keyring entry epoch 3 under a header at epoch 2
cases.rule: keyring holds exactly epochs 1 to epoch - 1
